Company Description

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Job Description

Start here. Grown Here.

We have an opportunity for a Consultant Town Planner.
AECOM’s Planning and Stakeholder Engagement business is recruiting Consultant Planners to help deliver our existing portfolio of projects and a pipeline of projects, across a range of sectors, principally delivering large scale infrastructure.

As our Town Planning team is national, and we support hybrid working we are flexible in terms of base location. The role can be based from our offices in Basingstoke, and London Aldgate,
with an option for hybrid working.

Here’s what you’ll do:

You will be joining a market leading, experienced infrastructure planning team and will, be given the following responsibilities.

Planning & Development Management

Assist in the management and successful delivery of major development applications.
Provide planning advice to colleagues and clients, including the application of permitted development rights.
Carry out planning research and analysis and assist with the identification of planning risks.

Technical Reporting & Documentation

Prepare Planning Statements and Design and Access Statements to support development applications.
Liaise with the Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) team to ensure coordinated project delivery.

Project Coordination & Delivery

Help coordinate multi-disciplinary teams across a variety of project types.
Assist with project management activities to support successful project outcomes.
Implement quality assurance and health and safety principles.

Business Development & Commercial Support

Contribute to the preparation of successful commercial tenders.

Stakeholder Engagement & Collaboration

Participate in internal and external meetings.
Build effective working relationships with colleagues, clients, and project stakeholders.

Does this sound like something you can do, and do well? If so, read on…

MORE ABOUT THE WORK
- We believe infrastructure creates opportunity for everyone. Whether it’s improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive.

We have an impressive portfolio of involvement in major infrastructure projects, including delivery of projects through various consenting regimes including Development Consent Orders. We are currently leading on consenting applications for renewables and wider energy/electricity related infrastructure, transport, defence, water and much more.

You will be able to work on a range of prestigious infrastructure projects for our clients in the energy transition, rail and water development sectors, as well as regional and local developments. AECOM is a market leader in UK infrastructure development, with experience of over 80 Nationally Significant Infrastructure Projects. Join us now and you could be working on:
numerous solar DCOs with a pipeline of future work;
carbon capture and energy storage projects;
energy transmission schemes including for National Grid’s Great Grid Upgrade;
large aviation and rail projects; and
housing and mixed-use development consenting.

PLANNING AT AECOM
- AECOM is a top ten UK Planning consultancy by size, employing around 70 Chartered or Licentiate Planners, practicing in all areas of the discipline. AECOM is also a worldwide leader in environmental and engineering consultancy and working as a planning consultant within AECOM means access to some of the highest profile and prestigious development projects in the UK, working with colleagues operating at the cutting edge of their disciplines as part of the largest UK environmental consultancy.

You will be joining a great team; you will have an interesting and diverse workload and you will be given the opportunity to make the most of your abilities.

What's not to like? Come and join us and we'll grow together.

Qualifications

Ready to push the limits of what’s possible?

Here’s what we’re looking for:

Professional Qualifications

Licentiate Member of the Royal Town Planning Institute (RTPI) or an equivalent professional town planning organisation and working towards full accreditation.

Planning & Technical Expertise

Demonstrable experience of working on major planning applications.
Sound knowledge of UK planning policy and legislation.
Experience of working on Development Consent Order (DCO) and/or Transport and Works Act Order (TWAO) applications.
Understanding of Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) legislation.
Experience identifying, evaluating, and managing planning risk.

Commercial & Consultancy Skills

Commercial awareness and the ability to write clearly and concisely.
Consultancy experience, including monitoring and managing project budgets and programmes.

Stakeholder & Team Collaboration

Client-focused with strong interpersonal skills and a collaborative working approach, demonstrating a high level of commitment to quality.
Experience working in collaborative, multi-disciplinary teams.

Project Delivery & Technical Competencies

Ability to work effectively to tight deadlines.
Competent in the use of Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Project.

Additional Information

Interested in the role or curious about life at AECOM? Follow us on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube to explore our AECOM voices, employee stories, latest projects, and much more!

AECOM is the world’s trusted infrastructure consulting firm, delivering professional services throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. On projects spanning transportation, buildings, water, new energy and the environment, our public- and private-sector clients trust us to solve their most complex challenges. Our teams are driven by a common purpose to deliver a better world through our unrivaled technical and digital expertise, a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion, and a commitment to environmental, social and governance priorities. You will help us foster a safe and respectful workplace, where we invite everyone to bring their whole selves to work using their unique talents, backgrounds and expertise to create transformational outcomes for our clients.

Join us, and you’ll get all the benefits of being a part of a global, publicly traded firm – access to industry-leading technology and thinking and transformational work with big impact and work flexibility. jobs.title: GIS Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Description

GIS Analyst – ArcGIS, SQL & GIS Application Development

Position Overview

Support highly complex GIS applications while working across spatial data, GIS application development, database technologies, testing, and web/mobile applications. This role provides opportunities to work closely with development teams and Project Managers to improve GIS solutions, streamline spatial data needs, and support application quality, milestones, and deadlines.

The role will primarily support applications associated with environmental and natural-resource functions, with additional application development support assigned as needed.

What You'll Do / Key Responsibilities

Support multiple highly complex GIS applications.
Collaborate with development staff by providing advice and guidance as needed.
Work closely with Project Managers to ensure project quality, milestones, and deadlines are met.
Develop solutions and streamline spatial data needs through the maintenance and modification of existing web, client/server, or mobile applications.
Support additional application development needs as assigned.
Adhere to applicable technology and client standards.
Develop or approve plans for testing and implementation of web-based, client/server, mobile, or data system applications.
Evaluate the impact of new technology and recommend solutions to persistent problems.
Serve as a customer service liaison to the client and external consultants.
Maintain current knowledge of changing IT technologies through continuous learning.
Support applications across PC-based, web-based, and mobile platforms.
Support legacy application development and maintenance where applicable.

Required Qualifications

4 years of experience in GIS, cartography, CADD, or a related field.
4 years of experience developing user interfaces, menus, and macro-level commands, performing complex spatial analyses, and producing reports according to customer specifications.
Experience with ArcGIS Online (AGOL) and Portal.
Builder skills.
Dashboard skills.
4 years of experience assisting in the development of GIS that create, maintain, or leverage geospatial basemap information.
Experience creating basemaps and tile caches.
Experience with imagery analysis.
4 years of advanced SQL skills, including writing database scripts, stored procedures, functions, triggers, and SSIS packages.
Experience maintaining spatial databases, documenting procedures, validating data, and updating and maintaining metadata for new and existing items.
4 years of advanced skills in unit testing, system testing, regression testing, and automated testing to ensure product quality meets client expectations.
2 years of experience with C#.NET, VB.NET, ASP.NET, XML, AJAX, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Transact SQL (T-SQL), TypeScript, and Power Apps.
Knowledge of ADA Compliance with 1+ years of experience.
Bachelor's degree required. Foreign degrees will be accepted if evaluated as equivalent to a U.S. bachelor's degree.

Preferred Qualifications

1+ years of experience with MS ADO, GIT, MS Office, and Helix.
1+ years of experience with Angular.

AECOM’s Urbanism + Planning practice is a continuum of design vision and strategic advisory that transforms communities. We lead through integration, shaping the social infrastructure that connects us all. U+P’s primary focus includes urban planning, urban design, landscape architecture, workplace strategy, business transformation, asset advisory, economics, and environmental planning.

With a range of expertise from strategy and design through project realization, we create better outcomes to grow economies, protect natural systems, conserve natural resources, make societies more equitable, and connect and engage people through innovative, sustainable design solutions.

Job Description

AECOM
is seeking a Senior Urban Planning Project Managerto support our growing Buildings & Places Business Line. At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. AECOM’s Urbanism + Planning team is seeking a creative and experienced urban planner or urban designer to join its practice to manage and contribute to complex projects.

The role will lead transformative, large-scale urban design and master planning projects across the East Coast, with a focus on TOD, mixed-use development, placemaking, downtown revitalization, and public realm design in the Washington, DC region. Working collaboratively with urban designers, planners, landscape architects, engineers, and economists, the urban planner or urban designer will provide planning and urban design leadership, project management, client engagement, and business development for municipal, state, and private-sector clients.

Our teams have worked on transformative planning and urban design projects for high profile clients through the United States, including for major transit, transportation, economic development, and planning agencies.

The job responsibilities for the position will include but are not limited to:

Project Management & Leadership:
In partnership with various Urbanism + Planning studios, lead complex, multidisciplinary projects from concept through implementation, including master plans, economic development strategies, land use and built form studies, public realm strategies, placemaking initiatives, and urban design guidelines.
Manage project scope, schedule, budget, work plans, and deliverables across multiple concurrent projects, project phases, and multidisciplinary teams.
Establish and maintain planning and urban design direction, quality, and consistency throughout project delivery while balancing innovation, feasibility, budget, and schedule.

Technical Support & Plan Production:
Prepare conditions assessments, land use and real estate analysis, diagrams and renderings, and high-quality presentations and reports that effectively communicate planning concepts, economic development considerations, and urban design vision for complex projects.
Lead and coordinate interdisciplinary teams, integrating civil, structural, transportation, environmental, landscape, and other technical disciplines into cohesive and viable planning and urban design solutions.
Translate complex planning and urban design concepts into clear, compelling diagrams, visualizations, reports, and presentations for a range of audiences.
Lead stakeholder engagement strategies and creative outreach efforts, including brand development, professional templates and style guides, event planning, meeting facilitation, online forums, and digital tools.

Client Relationships & Business Development:
Lead and support client presentations, workshops, stakeholder meetings, and public engagement sessions with confidence, enthusiasm, and clarity.
Lead and support proposal development, scopes of work, fee and budget development, work plans, and project interviews.
Support client relationship-building efforts, identifying opportunities to expand existing relationships and develop new business.
Represent AECOM by presenting at industry conferences and through participation in organizations.

Qualifications

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:
BA/BS in Planning, Urban Design, Landscape Architecture or related field + 8 years of related experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education
Demonstrated project management experience on complex, multidisciplinary, large-scale planning, urban design, and economic development projects, especially in urban and mixed-use contexts

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:
Masters Degree in Planning, Urban Design, Landscape Architecture or related field
Business development experience, including supporting and leading urban design and planning proposals for public sector and private sector clients
Significant experience producing high-quality written narrative and graphics for reports and presentations, with the ability to present ideas effectively to internal and external audiences
Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign).
Advanced proficiency directing and reviewing urban design production, including 2D and 3D site plans, building massing studies, diagrams, and renderings
Proficiency in GIS and map-based data analytics
Positive, proactive approach to teamwork and problem-solving
Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail
Excellent time management skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines
AICP certification or active pursuit of certification preferred

Additional Information

Sponsorship for US employment authorization is not available now or in the future for this position.
Relocation is not available for this position.

Job Description

GIS Analyst – ArcGIS, SQL & GIS Application Development

Position Overview

Support highly complex GIS applications while working across spatial data, GIS application development, database technologies, testing, and web/mobile applications. This role provides opportunities to work closely with development teams and Project Managers to improve GIS solutions, streamline spatial data needs, and support application quality, milestones, and deadlines.

The role will primarily support applications associated with environmental and natural-resource functions, with additional application development support assigned as needed.

What You'll Do / Key Responsibilities

Support multiple highly complex GIS applications.
Collaborate with development staff by providing advice and guidance as needed.
Work closely with Project Managers to ensure project quality, milestones, and deadlines are met.
Develop solutions and streamline spatial data needs through the maintenance and modification of existing web, client/server, or mobile applications.
Support additional application development needs as assigned.
Adhere to applicable technology and client standards.
Develop or approve plans for testing and implementation of web-based, client/server, mobile, or data system applications.
Evaluate the impact of new technology and recommend solutions to persistent problems.
Serve as a customer service liaison to the client and external consultants.
Maintain current knowledge of changing IT technologies through continuous learning.
Support applications across PC-based, web-based, and mobile platforms.
Support legacy application development and maintenance where applicable.

Required Qualifications

4 years of experience in GIS, cartography, CADD, or a related field.
4 years of experience developing user interfaces, menus, and macro-level commands, performing complex spatial analyses, and producing reports according to customer specifications.
Experience with ArcGIS Online (AGOL) and Portal.
Builder skills.
Dashboard skills.
4 years of experience assisting in the development of GIS that create, maintain, or leverage geospatial basemap information.
Experience creating basemaps and tile caches.
Experience with imagery analysis.
4 years of advanced SQL skills, including writing database scripts, stored procedures, functions, triggers, and SSIS packages.
Experience maintaining spatial databases, documenting procedures, validating data, and updating and maintaining metadata for new and existing items.
4 years of advanced skills in unit testing, system testing, regression testing, and automated testing to ensure product quality meets client expectations.
2 years of experience with C#.NET, VB.NET, ASP.NET, XML, AJAX, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Transact SQL (T-SQL), TypeScript, and Power Apps.
Knowledge of ADA Compliance with 1+ years of experience.

These responsibilities focus on  portfolio and trade surveillance
to ensure that the firm maintains compliance with client guidelines and regulatory requirements, conducting transactional, forensic testing and compliance reviews.

As a member of the Compliance team, you will work closely with portfolio managers, traders, operations, and senior compliance professionals while taking on meaningful responsibilities.

Pre and post trade investment compliance monitoring

Compliance program monitoring and testing
Code of ethics monitoring
Preparation of regulatory filings (13F, ADV, Form PF)
Trade surveillance
Adhoc projects

Support pre- and post-trade investment compliance monitoring for client accounts and mutual fund portfolios using EZE Compliance, including client guidelines, mutual fund trade restrictions, and UCITS requirements.

Overview

When you join Hines, you will embark on a career journey fueled by vision and guided by leaders who set the standards of our industry. Our legacy is rooted in innovation and excellence, earning us a spot on Fast Company’s esteemed annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies, as well as recognition as one of U.S. News & World Report’s Best Companies to Work For in 2024. Discover endless opportunities to grow and make your mark at Hines.

Responsibilities

Hybrid position requiring at least three days per week in-office and regular travel to properties to meet business needs. Title and compensation will depend on skill level and experience.
Leveraging an AI-first approach, our Analyst and Lead Analyst role is a hands-on field technologist responsible for deploying, configuring, monitoring, and supporting technology infrastructure across a distributed real estate portfolio — including new developments, acquisitions, and management services assignments. This role is embedded in the field, regularly deployed to properties, and requires deep fluency in OT/building systems, cybersecurity, and enterprise networking within real estate and construction environments.

Field Deployment & Property Execution
Execute infrastructure scope for new property onboardings, acquisitions, and management services engagements, including ISP coordination, circuit turn-up support, and technology transitions.
Support end-to-end implementation of technology infrastructure for new developments and major capital improvement projects.
Review low-voltage drawings, technical specifications, and as-built documentation to support accurate implementation.
Coordinate with vendors, integrators, and service providers to manage implementation tasks, lead times, issue resolution, and delivery risks.

OT/Building Systems & Cybersecurity
Support infrastructure requirements for physical security systems, building automation systems (BAS/BMS), access control systems (ACS), CCTV, and other safety-critical environments.
Apply OT/IT cybersecurity frameworks and principles across all deployments, including firewall rule implementation, network segmentation, redundancy support, failover validation, and secure remote administration.
Identify and mitigate cybersecurity risks specific to OT environments, including connected building systems, converged networks, and smart infrastructure.
Ensure all OT deployments and operational activities comply with local regulations, company cybersecurity policies, and applicable industry standards.
Support ongoing vulnerability management, firmware hygiene, and security monitoring activities across the property portfolio.

Network Infrastructure & Operations
Execute deployment, configuration, validation, and support of enterprise network and infrastructure standards across corporate and property environments, including wireless, switching, firewalls, and site connectivity.
Perform advanced troubleshooting, configuration changes, firmware updates, device reviews, and remote support using secure access tooling.
Monitor infrastructure environments, analyze alerts and event data, identify root causes, and initiate remediation actions.

Cross-Functional Coordination
Partner with Technology, Management Services, Engineering, and Construction teams to execute project deliverables and resolve field-level constraints.
Serve as lead technical resource for complex or high-impact infrastructure issues requiring hands-on analysis and timely escalation.

Documentation & Compliance
Maintain site-level and portfolio-level visibility into infrastructure deployments, system readiness, and remediation activity using enterprise service and project management tools.
Ensure complete and accurate documentation, inventories, configuration records, and support notes are maintained.
Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in MIS, Computer Science, or a related field from an accredited institution preferred or equivalent years of direct experience required.
Professional Experience: 3–10 years of experience in OT infrastructure, enterprise networking, or technology operations, preferably within real estate, construction, or other distributed environment sectors. Title (Analyst vs Lead Analyst) and corresponding compensation will be based on experience and skill level.
Hands-on experience in enterprise infrastructure, network operations, or technology support across multi-site or distributed environments.
Practical experience leveraging AI tooling to realize insight and efficiency.
Demonstrated experience configuring and supporting enterprise network and wireless environments, including firewalls, VPNs, switching, redundancy, and failover models.
Experience supporting construction projects, property portfolios, or multi-site environments with active renovations, transitions, or onsite implementation activities preferred.
Experience monitoring infrastructure environments, analyzing alerts, troubleshooting incidents, and driving remediation activities in operational scenarios.
Strong working knowledge of vendor and ISP coordination, technical execution, and service delivery support.
Project Management: Proficiency with tools like Procore, Bluebeam Revu, Jira, or Smartsheet is a plus.
Clear written and verbal communication skills with the ability to document technical work and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Ability and willingness to provide hands-on technical support while maintaining strong ownership, accountability, and communication practices.
Proven ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-paced, and high-pressure environments with cross-functional stakeholders.
Strong working knowledge of OT/IT networking inc. converged networks, and typical connected building systems (i.e., BAS, BMS, ACS, CCTV).
Base competency of modern building systems & “smart” infrastructure.
Strong working knowledge of wireless technologies (i.e., DAS, managed Wi-Fi) preferred.

Strong cross-functional coordination, technical execution, and stakeholder management.

Assess and address gaps in deployment and best practices, translating them into strategic action plans for improvement.
Ensure customers achieve operational excellence by fully adopting and optimizing new features.
Act as a strategic advisor, influencing key stakeholders at various levels, including C-suite executives.
Manage complex customer engagements, collaborating with account teams to develop and execute high-touch delivery strategies.
Lead customer escalations, coordinating with internal teams and resources to ensure timely and effective resolution.

Bachelor of Science in Computer Science or related Technical Field (or equivalent experience).
5+ years of hands-on experience in cloud infrastructure and large-scale network design, operations, and security.
3+ years of experience in a customer-facing or advisory role (such as Customer Success, Consulting, or Support Engineering).
Proven track record in driving product adoption, leading complex feature implementations, and delivering advanced training programs.
Ability to translate technical requirements into actionable plans, guiding customers through advanced use cases.
Demonstrated ability to build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including executive-level contacts.
High-level consultative skills, capable of influencing decisions and driving customer success strategies.
Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) encompassed technology, standards, and implementations.
Securing Internet applications, e.g., cryptography, standards, techniques.
Directory technologies and standards, e.g., LDAP, Active Directory.

Familiarity with Public Certificate Authorities (e.g., DigiCert, Sectigo, Let's Encrypt, Entrust).

Experience with automation and configuration management tools like Ansible or Terraform, for deploying and managing security infrastructure.
